title: Janet Welsh — Family & Biography

# Janet Welsh (~1835–1914)

**Role:** Wife of James Telfer (1829–1914)

Janet Welsh married James Telfer (1829–1914), son of James Telfer (1796–1863) and Elizabeth Beattie. James was the first child born to his parents in Australia after their arrival from Scotland.

**Source:** *From the Borders to the Bush*
